description: `filter_complex` containing `|` and `;` (ffmpeg's own filter-graph separators) must succeed -- the shell-metacharacter check `flags` gets does not apply to it. The companion `c-ffmpeg-unsafe-input`/`c-ffmpeg-unsafe-filter-complex` cases cover the two checks' own remaining metacharacters failing; this is the one place the two safety-check tiers diverge for the exact same characters.
